basis: Ten newly rendered full-case QGIS detail images inspected visually

T11.observation: C3 orientation follows roof, but minor mask projections remain; preserved C1 omits an eastern roof projection. Do not generalize acceptance to the whole case.

T12.observation: Three principal roofs visible, but C2 has nearby NoData and adjoining brown surfaces need classification; C3 has small irregular edge fragments.

T13.observation: Gray roof under tree cover; exact western and southern steps remain uncertain, not automatically a simple complete footprint.

T14.observation: Small unsupported triangular projections remain at southwest/northwest edges; adjoining pale flat surfaces and southern covered extension need interpretation.

T15.observation: Four-corner outline follows visible principal flat roof; no owner acceptance or positional accuracy measurement.

T16.observation: Three simpler roof planes are useful; junction offsets and small roof extensions remain to inspect. Separate roof planes do not establish separate cadastral identities.

T17.observation: Main roof and long gray neighbor preserved; courtyard contains a smaller covered structure, so the hole must not be treated as a wholly proven open courtyard or missing structure ignored.

T18.observation: Main roof and west wing separated as hypotheses; exact common junction and small extensions need finishing; brown annex remains provisional.

T19.observation: Articulated main roof recovered; staircase/entrance connection and small edge offsets remain outside or near contour. Not complete building inventory.

T20.observation: Two principal rectangular roofs follow visible edges with thin ducts excluded; adjacent equipment area not identified as roof without evidence.
